name: Playbook_Runner
description: Executes pre-defined JSON sequences of SOC tools (Playbooks) for rapid automated workflows.

arguments.name: JSON Playbook
arguments.description: Name of the JSON playbook in the Playbooks folder (e.g., ai_analysis_pipeline.json)

arguments.name: Dynamic Target
arguments.description: File or folder path injected into playbook steps (used for {{DYNAMIC_TARGET}})

name: Tool_Indexer
description: Scans the toolkit and updates the Commander Registry.

name: Data_Ingestor_Pipeline
description: Unified pipeline for ingesting files (or folders), sanitizing PII/PHI using pseudo-NLP, scrubbing network IOCs, and formatting data.

arguments.name: Target File or Folder
arguments.description: Path to the file or folder to sanitize

arguments.name: Processing Mode
arguments.description: 1 (Logs), 2 (OSINT), or 3 (Comprehensive)

name: base64_decoder
description: Extracts, cleans, and decodes Base64 payloads from raw text or files. Ideal for de-obfuscating PowerShell payloads or malicious scripts.

arguments.name: Target File or Text
arguments.description: File containing Base64 or a raw Base64 string

name: cve_intel_fetcher
description: Instantly queries the NIST NVD database for a specific CVE to return its CVSS score, summary, and exploit status.

arguments.name: CVE ID
arguments.description: The specific CVE identifier to query (e.g., CVE-2023-12345)

name: IOC_Extractor
description: High-fidelity extractor that pulls IPs, MACs, URLs, and Hashes from files. Defangs outputs for safe playbook automation.

arguments.name: Target File or Folder
arguments.description: Path to the file or folder to scan

name: pki_cert_decoder
description: Decodes and analyzes X.509 certificates (.pem, .cer, .der, or raw base64) locally without external network calls.

arguments.name: Certificate File
arguments.description: Path to the certificate file to analyze

name: Threat_Intel_Fetcher
description: Aggregates live intel from CISA KEV, CISA Advisories, and Abuse.ch into a single comprehensive daily bundle. Ready for playbook automation.

arguments.name: Compare Directory
arguments.description: Directory containing Extracted IOC CSVs to cross-reference

name: AI_Analyst_Engine
description: Fuses an AI Skill from the Knowledge Base with raw evidence to generate a structured analysis prompt.

arguments.name: Evidence File
arguments.description: Path to the file containing raw logs or data to analyze

name: AI_Response_Rehydrator
description: Replaces placeholder tokens (e.g., HOST_1, IPV4_1) in an AI response with real values from the sanitizer mapping file.

arguments.name: AI Response File
arguments.description: Path to the AI model output to rehydrate

arguments.name: Mapping File
arguments.description: Optional path to the .map.json produced by the sanitizer

name: Automated_Reporter
description: Compiles text summaries and sanitized intelligence into a standardized, shareable HTML SOC briefing document.

arguments.name: Input Mode
arguments.description: 1 for File, 2 for Paste

name: Case_Bundle_Builder
description: Builds a consolidated incident case bundle from a folder of exports.

arguments.name: Source Directory
arguments.description: Folder containing raw exports for this case

name: mde_triage_aggregator
description: Designed EXCLUSIVELY for raw Microsoft Defender (MDE) CSV exports. Use this to deduplicate incident storms, prune false positive noise, and format High-Severity alerts for shift handoff.

arguments.name: CSV File
arguments.description: Path to the raw MDE Incident or Alert CSV export

name: Splunk_Notable_AI_Helper
description: Guided helper that takes a sanitized Splunk ES Incident Review notable export and builds an AI prompt asking for SPL, disposition, and a two-sentence closing comment.

arguments.name: Evidence File
arguments.description: Path to the sanitized notable text or export (optional; will prompt if omitted)

name: splunk_notable_parser
description: Parses raw Splunk exports using aggressive Regex to extract actionable IOCs (IPs, Emails, Hashes) hidden within unstructured log data.

arguments.name: Splunk CSV/TXT File
arguments.description: Path to the raw Splunk export

name: AI_Context_Exporter
description: Bundles source code, configs, and directory structure into a single text file for AI context sharing.

name: AI_Skill_Browser
description: Interactive browser for SOC AI SKILL files stored in the Knowledge Base.

name: AI_Skill_Harvester
description: Scans the user Downloads directory for scattered AI SKILL.md files, centralizes them, and generates an index.

name: Dir_Mapper
description: Generates a comprehensive, indented file and folder map of the Downloads directory and saves it to the root platform folder.

name: Git_Sync_Manager
description: Interactive Git utility to safely pull updates, stash changes, and push code to the central repo.

name: Maintenance_Suite
description: Interactive hub for cleaning the workspace, generating AI context exports, or backing up the platform.

name: Platform_Blueprint
description: Scans the SOC platform to map all folder paths, files, metadata, and source code into a single document.

name: Platform_Health_Check
description: Validates Commander registry, tool scripts, and playbook references for basic integrity.

name: Splunk_Env_Profile_Builder
description: Scans a local folder of Splunk index/sourcetype metadata and refreshes splunk_env_profile.json with role→SPL fragments.

arguments.name: Source Directory
arguments.description: Folder containing ROLE-marked index/sourcetype reference files

name: Splunk_Env_Profile_Editor
description: Interactive editor for splunk_env_profile.json role→SPL fragments (indexes/sourcetypes).

name: System_Downloads_Mapper
description: Scans your actual Windows User Downloads folder and generates a complete file map saved to the SOC root.

name: text_reformatter
description: Reflows garbled text with hard-wrapped lines into cleaner paragraphs for AI analysis.

arguments.name: Target Text File
arguments.description: Path to the text file to reflow

arguments.name: Line Width
arguments.description: Desired wrap width (default 100)

name: Text_Sanitizer_Pipeline
description: Reflows garbled text and sanitizes IPs, MACs, and common PII/PHI before opening in Notepad.

arguments.name: Target Text File
arguments.description: Path to the text file to sanitize directly

arguments.name: Input Mode
arguments.description: 1 (Paste), 2 (File Drag & Drop)

arguments.name: Line Width
arguments.description: Desired wrap width (default 100)

name: Tool_Packager
description: Compresses the SOC platform into a ZIP, injecting a resilient launcher and dynamically generated README.

name: Workspace_Cleaner
description: Organizes legacy tools into archives, consolidates paperwork, and safely removes empty directories.

name: bulk_rule_matcher
description: No description provided.

name: closure_notes_generator
description: No description provided.

name: es_rules_importer
description: No description provided.

name: filecheck
description: Reliably counts lines, searches for phrases, and hashes a file (Interactive).

name: splunk_csv_ingestor
description: No description provided.

name: splunk_folder_watcher
description: No description provided.
